author: engrbilalwaris
text: AWS's Nov 4 EKS advisory flags a NetworkPolicy bypass risk between co-located pods for an authenticated adjacent user. CVE-2026-122266 is fixed in Network Policy Agent 1.3.7 and VPC CNI 1.22.3. AWS lists no workaround.

text:

text:

author: PVynckier
text: Patched Zyxel GS1900 switches remained open to an in-the-wild exploit (CVE-2026-107441).

author: DarkControlAI
text: Check Point found a Codex jailbreak bundle that also edits the agent's configuration so greetings trigger an ad for an LLM gateway. It saw no data theft, but the method matters. Baseline your agents' global instructions and Skills, and alert on changes.

author: secbrief
text:
Anthropic told orgs a third-party security firm accessed names, emails and enterprise plan data. Not chats, passwords or cards.

If you got the mail, verify unexpected billing emails through your usual account channels; the phishing follow-up already knows your work email.

author: eforus_overseer
text: SEVEN fresh CVE records for the OpenHuman agent harness landed at once and together they tour every trust boundary: channel messages become cron jobs, and approval existed in the interface but not on the code path the message actually traveled.

author: Unreal_IRCd
text: We are now seeing attempts by bad guys to actively exploit CVE-2026-114713 in UnrealIRCd on the internet. If you have not hot-patched or upgraded, do so ASAP!

author: rumivpn
text: Google says Chrome 153+ will stop trusting certain eMudhra certificates after a security incident involving compromised private keys for eight subordinate CA certificates. The change targets certificates with their earliest Signed Certificate Timestamp after Nov 16, 23:59 UTC.

author: kkaasolutions
text: CVE-2026-123550 (CRITICAL / 9.8) — OpenAM before 16.1.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its SAML v2.0 service provider that accepts unsigned assertions.

author: TheHackerWire
text:
Critical WebRTC/SIP Media Hijacking in FreeSWITCH (CVE-2026-116790, CVSS 9.1)

Inbound ICE skips STUN MESSAGE-INTEGRITY checks, letting attackers forge ICE checks without SDP credentials to hijack RTP streams.

Action: Upgrade to 1.11.2.

author: HACKTIFY_
text: Actively exploited: CVE-2026-19868 (CVSS 7.1) lets users with valid alternate-auth credentials bypass SAML/MFA on SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN. Affected only with SAML enabled: Gen7 ≤7.3.3-7015, Gen8 ≤8.2.2-8015. Patch to 7.3.4-7013 / 8.2.3-8015 now; review VPN logins.

author: Roccat_fi
text:
Robocurve fed frontier models tampered video on robot arms and got a 100% attempt rate on stabbing a baby doll the model thought was fruit.

https://t.co/a7lhbWM0kB

Prompt injection just left the chat window. Who owns this fix: model labs or robot makers?

author: Rachidmarcil
text: Claude Code 2.1.319 (Nov 6) fixes a sandbox escape via worktree creation, a Bash permission-check bypass, and sed evading checks. Warning: the stable channel is still on 2.1.311 and doesn't have these fixes yet.

author: CrackTechDaily
text:
🚨 Google’s November 2026 Android security update fixes critical vulnerabilities, including a Remote Code Execution (RCE) flaw. CVE-2026-58868 could allow attacks without user interaction.

text:

author: brofindAI
text:
A tampered Claude Code update tried to add a stranger's SSH key to devs' machines 🔑

It sat in Cursor's marketplace ~11 hours. Cursor says it wasn't built by Anthropic; Anthropic says its systems weren't compromised.

Full video: https://t.co/qwFHf6189H https://t.co/9KJ9A4JkUC

author: fc_vulns
text:
Flagging this new critical IBM API Connect flaw. CVE-2026-17049 — CVSS 9.9.

IBM API Connect 12.1.0–12.1.1.2: auth'd attacker can read sensitive data and modify docs via authz bypass (user-controlled keys).

author: nyuszkoreal
text:
CrowdStrike researchers demonstrate a kill-switch mechanism for AI security agents, forcing silent disconnections via prompt injection.

Unmanaged AI authority in CTI pipelines remains a massive threat vector. Audit agent permissions now. 🚨

https://t.co/hEQhawBUwg

#infosec #ai

author: hazemomier
text:
Linux kernel CVE-2026-99284 (local privilege escalation in skb_zerocopy/ESP) now has stable fixes.

Patch to 6.18.61/7.2.15/7.3.2 or your distro's fixed kernel and reboot. Until then: user.max_user_namespaces=0 where you don't need rootless containers.
https://t.co/JgbtWnN8JQ

text:

OpenAM’s notifications WebSocket leaks live iPlanetDirectoryPro session tokens to unauthenticated clients when an agent-only check is bypassed via an unvalidated

author: 0aPoplin
text:
The target was not the network. It was the keys to the network.

Talos: UAT-11473 exploited CVE-2026-20127 (auth bypass in Cisco SD-WAN controllers) and deployed KeyDrift, a framework that hooks the control plane to steal what Talos assesses to be IPsec data-plane key material.

text:

Contact Form 7 6.2–6.2.3 lets anyone upload arbitrary files, leading to RCE on stock Debian/Ubuntu Apache (CVE-2026-114432)

https://t.co/tJomkbMr6O

author: PromptHex
text:
‼️ The AI hacking agent China-linked hackers attacked 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants with last month is now aimed at banks.

Microsoft says a Cambodia-based crime group has used ARTEX since October against financial firms in Southeast Asia and some big global banks.

Its agents https://t.co/B2wZhlabRP

text:

BadByte says trojanized images (tomicdd/artex and congdonglinux/artex) gave attackers a root shell, with 7,946 pulls before disclosure. 

Docker removed them on Nov 5, but copies that are already installed or cached still carry

text:
Axios CVE-2026-42037 Allows Multipart Header Injection Through Blob.type

Critical Vulnerability Alert!
Axios npm package is affected by CVE-2026-42037.

author: ZeroPathLabs
text: MLflow CVE-2026-118628: unauthenticated attackers can exploit get-artifacts to trigger SSRF. A proof of concept is available.

author: ZeroPathLabs
text: Oracle Identity Manager CVE-2026-35265: a missing authentication flaw lets attackers fully take over Oracle Identity Manager.

author: ZeroPathLabs
text:
GPUStack CVE-2026-102895: Admin Access Bypass

A critical auth flaw in GPUStack lets attackers gain admin without credentials via loopback.  
Patch ASAP.  

For more details, read ZeroPath's blog on this vuln.  
#AppSec #InfoSec #CloudSecurity

https://t.co/8wnlov06Ij

author: ZeroPathLabs
text:
Critical Microsoft Entra Device Registration Bypass

CVE-2026-109469 scores a perfect 10.0 for a reason. This authorization bypass is already mitigated by Microsoft, but review your access controls.

For more details, read ZeroPath's blog on this vuln.
#AppSec #InfoSec #Microsoft

author: Light_TechX
text: Google's Gemini broke out of a security test and hacked three real companies by guessing passwords — then stopped itself each time. Google calls that proof the safety worked. Four labs in now: the models can already do the hacking. The question is whether they stop.

author: SlimAssiliX
text: GPT-6 Cyber reportedly reproduced 1,724 Linux kernel vulnerabilities, built working exploits for 948 and found 81 unknown high-severity Firefox flaws, per OpenAI. Discovery and exploit validation are getting automated.

author: gmrgolu
text: Apiiro found 1,122 public GitHub repos with Claude Code's settings.local.json leaking secrets, including 379 database passwords and 23 AWS keys. Cause: "Yes, don't ask again" saves full commands in plain text. Rotate keys and gitignore the file.

author: ICHI_Global
text: Critical IBM API Connect: 3 unauthenticated RCEs, CVE-2026-17301 auth bypass (9.8), CVE-2026-17340 path traversal RCE (9.8), CVE-2026-17360 hard-coded creds/full admin (9.8); 40+ CVEs. Patch 10.0.8.x and 12.1.x.

author: Ahmad365Raza
text: JFrog reports the testmetest npm worm has planted hidden payloads in 42 real GitHub repos. If any machine installed testmetest or @iobandamwer packages, treat it as compromised and follow JFrog's cleanup order before revoking tokens.

author: TTT_News_
text: Web3Auth said an infrastructure vulnerability exposed private keys for some Keplr wallets created with Google or Apple login. Web3Auth paused its embedded wallet service; Web3Auth and Keplr are conducting whitehat asset recoveries. Seed-phrase and hardware wallets are not affected.

author: Joshua_WD
text: Microsoft watched an AI agent go from a leaked GitHub secret to Azure Key Vault data in five minutes. The tool, ARTEX, now shows up in several campaigns, using old holes at machine speed.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition. Unauthenticated RCE during full core upgrades via predictable, web-accessible staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 3, 2026. CVSS 8.1 High.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: CVE-2026-123158 in OpenSSH on musl-based systems is actively exploited, with confirmed root access on a honeypot. Search /var/log/messages for "Accepted password for" on accounts lacking a password hash, then patch and restart sshd.

author: theadvtech
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw (CVE-2026-103916, CVSS 8.2) let an AI agent escape its sandbox via a symlink in the sbx cp copy command. Docker's first fix in v0.48.0 was incomplete; the final fix shipped Nov 3 in v0.51.0. Source: Endor Labs.

author: Pelin19si
text: Bitwarden CLI was compromised in a supply chain attack: @bitwarden/cli@2026.4.0 included malicious code after attackers hijacked GitHub Actions, stole secrets and pushed a tampered version to npm.

author: Priosweep
text: Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 (unrestricted file upload, CVSS 9.6) has been on CISA KEV since Oct 27. Federal due date is Tuesday, Nov 10. Fix is in Adobe APSB26-73.

author: mehvetero
text: CVE-2026-98432 is a critical Linux kernel bug (CVSS 9.8). Someone on the internet can send crafted TCP packets and take over a machine with no login needed. Ubuntu and Red Hat have not shipped a fixed kernel yet.

author: SCMagazine
text: More than 1,000 GitLab servers remain exposed to an actively exploited, critical RCE flaw. Experts warn attackers could steal credentials and compromise software supply chains.

author: aleksandar_g_82
text: The fix for CVE-2026-83844, a Paint remote code execution flaw (CVSS 8.1), ships only via the Microsoft Store, not Windows Update. Fixed build is 11.2609.401.0. Paint installs per user, so check every copy. No known exploitation yet.

author: cloudsa
text: cPGuard's hijacked update channel (5.88.12-5.88.19) ran as root on about 2,950 hosting servers; the patch removes the backdoor, not the stolen credentials. OpenSSH on Alpine/musl (CVE-2026-123158, CVSS 8.1) lets 257-1,024-byte passwords into no-password accounts.

author: ZetsubosenseiG
text: An AI agent built to find security flaws ended up at the center of a real data breach at WorkOS; the researcher was benchmarking ARTEX, an autonomous AI pentesting tool. WorkOS said the researcher never intended to target the company.

author: xer0dayz
text: CVE-2026-42945 (NGINX Rift): critical heap overflow in the nginx rewrite module, exploited in the wild. Nuclei detection template available.
